prompts.title: Collector Specification Sheet
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive creative director and editorial designer specializing in luxury automotive brochures, industrial design presentations, and museum-quality collector posters.

Your work combines the visual language of:

• Porsche Design Studio
• Apple Industrial Design
• Dieter Rams
• Braun
• Swiss Graphic Design
• Monocle Magazine
• Porsche Press Kits
• BMW Heritage Catalogs
• Mercedes-Benz Design Books
• Automotive Engineering Specification Sheets

The result must look like an official manufacturer design document—not an AI-generated poster.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Design a premium automotive collector specification sheet.

NOT an advertisement.

NOT a movie poster.

NOT a social media graphic.

Instead create an official-looking concept vehicle presentation that could be printed inside a manufacturer's confidential design portfolio.

The design should feel timeless, restrained, luxurious, and extremely expensive.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Orientation:
Portrait

Aspect Ratio:
4:5

Resolution:
8K

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

Museum Quality

Perfect Typography

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[BODY STYLE]

Preserve the exact proportions, body lines, wheels, headlights, grille, mirrors, windows, badges, and overall identity of the vehicle.

Ultra photorealistic.

No redesign.

No exaggerated proportions.

--------------------------------------------------

# MAIN IMAGE

Large hero render occupying approximately 55–60% of the page.

Three-quarter front view.

Low camera angle.

85mm lens.

Slight steering angle.

Studio photography.

Perfect reflections.

Luxury automotive lighting.

The vehicle should dominate the composition while maintaining generous negative space.

--------------------------------------------------

# BACKGROUND

Minimal off-white museum paper.

Warm white.

Very subtle texture.

Soft gradient only.

No scenery.

No roads.

No buildings.

No sky.

No environment.

No distracting graphics.

--------------------------------------------------

# LAYOUT

Strict Swiss Grid.

Everything perfectly aligned.

Large margins.

Consistent spacing.

Invisible baseline grid.

Professional editorial hierarchy.

Every section aligned precisely.

Nothing randomly placed.

--------------------------------------------------

# HEADER

Small brand name.

Large model name.

Large year.

Small "Concept" or "Vision" subtitle.

One short design philosophy sentence.

Example:

"The next chapter of electric performance."

--------------------------------------------------

# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Create a professional engineering specification table.

Include:

Powertrain

Engine

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Drive Type

Battery Capacity

Range

Acceleration

Top Speed

Length

Width

Height

Wheelbase

Weight

Seats

Body Style

Platform

Use thin divider lines.

Perfect alignment.

Minimal typography.

--------------------------------------------------

# ENGINEERING DRAWINGS

Generate clean technical line drawings of the same vehicle.

Include:

Side View

Front View

Rear View

Top View

Dimension arrows.

Measurements.

Fine engineering lines.

Blueprint aesthetic.

Minimal grayscale.

--------------------------------------------------

# DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Create a short editorial paragraph describing:

• Design language
• Aerodynamics
• Performance philosophy
• Materials
• Driver experience

Professional automotive editorial tone.

Never sound like marketing.

--------------------------------------------------

# PERFORMANCE ICONS

Include minimal monochrome icons representing:

Performance

Precision

Electric

Aerodynamics

Innovation

Driver Focus

Lightweight

--------------------------------------------------

# SPECIMEN SECTION

Bottom-right corner.

Collector edition label.

Example:

Specimen

01 / 100

Limited Concept Series

Small barcode.

Internal reference number.

--------------------------------------------------

# FOOTER

Very small typography.

Examples:

Renault Design Center

Concept Vehicle

Internal Development Program

Confidential Prototype

Design Archive

Engineering Division

--------------------------------------------------

# TYPOGRAPHY

Swiss Sans Serif.

Large hierarchy.

Perfect kerning.

Perfect tracking.

Editorial spacing.

Modern typography.

Minimal.

Elegant.

No decorative fonts.

--------------------------------------------------

# COLOR PALETTE

95% monochrome.

White

Warm White

Black

Dark Grey

Light Grey

Allow only the actual vehicle color to remain.

Everything else should stay neutral.

--------------------------------------------------

# LIGHTING

Professional automotive studio.

Large softboxes.

HDR.

Soft reflections.

Controlled highlights.

Realistic metallic paint.

Detailed carbon fiber.

Detailed glass.

Detailed tires.

Detailed wheels.

Ray-traced reflections.

Physically accurate lighting.

--------------------------------------------------

# MATERIALS

Photorealistic.

No CGI appearance.

No illustration style.

Real aluminum.

Real carbon fiber.

Real rubber.

Real paint texture.

Real glass.

Microscopic surface detail.

--------------------------------------------------

# STYLE

Apple Design

Porsche Brochure

BMW Heritage

Mercedes-Benz Press Kit

Industrial Design Presentation

Swiss Graphic Design

Museum Exhibition Catalog

Automotive Design Portfolio

Luxury Print Publication

Confidential Engineering Documentation

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No scenery

No roads

No mountains

No city

No people

No drivers

No motion blur

No smoke

No racing effects

No explosions

No colorful graphics

No visual clutter

No comic style

No cartoon

No painterly look

No CGI look

No unrealistic reflections

No exaggerated proportions

No incorrect wheels

No fake badges

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

No low-quality typography

No distorted perspective

No unnecessary decorative elements

--------------------------------------------------

# FINAL RESULT

The final image should look indistinguishable from an official confidential concept vehicle specification sheet created by Renault, Porsche, BMW, or Mercedes-Benz for internal design review.

It should feel collectible, museum-worthy, timeless, elegant, technically precise, and expensive enough to be framed in a luxury automotive design studio.

prompts.title: Macro Detail Series
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive photographer, industrial designer, and luxury editorial art director specializing in macro automotive photography.

Your work combines:

• Leica Photography
• Hasselblad Editorial
• Apple Product Photography
• Porsche Design Studio
• Bugatti Design Books
• Pagani Detail Photography
• Swiss Editorial Design
• Luxury Watch Advertising

The goal is not to showcase the whole vehicle.

The goal is to celebrate craftsmanship.

Every image should make the viewer appreciate the engineering, materials, precision, and beauty of individual components.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Create a premium "Macro Detail Series" collector poster.

The poster is composed of multiple ultra-close-up photographs of one vehicle.

Each photograph highlights a specific design element.

The collection should feel like a luxury design study rather than an advertisement.

Every crop must look intentional.

Every surface should communicate quality.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Portrait

4:5

8K

Museum Quality

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

[CAR MODEL]

Brand:

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Preserve the exact identity of the vehicle.

Maintain authentic materials, proportions, finishes, and branding.

Modern Swiss Grid.

Asymmetrical layout.

Large margins.

prompts.title: Neoclassical style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Neoclassical style.

Inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece and Rome, emphasize perfect symmetry, balance, proportion, and timeless elegance. Incorporate marble architecture, Corinthian and Ionic columns, decorative moldings, arches, pediments, sculptural reliefs, laurel wreaths, and geometric patterns where appropriate. Use luxurious materials such as polished white marble, limestone, bronze, brass, rich wood, and subtle gold accents. Apply a refined color palette of ivory, cream, warm beige, charcoal, muted gray, deep navy, emerald, and soft gold. The composition should feel prestigious, noble, harmonious, and timeless. Use soft natural lighting, exceptional craftsmanship, clean composition, intricate details, museum-quality aesthetics, cinematic realism, ultra-high detail, 8K.

prompts.title: Baroque style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Baroque style.

Inspired by the opulence and theatrical grandeur of 17th-century European Baroque art and architecture, emphasize dramatic movement, lavish ornamentation, rich textures, and emotional intensity. Incorporate elaborate scrollwork, gilded carvings, floral motifs, cherubs, ornate frames, grand arches, domes, fresco-inspired details, intricate reliefs, and luxurious decorative patterns where appropriate. Use premium materials such as polished marble, carved wood, velvet, silk, crystal, brass, bronze, and abundant gold leaf accents. Apply a rich color palette of deep crimson, royal blue, emerald green, burgundy, ivory, black, warm cream, and antique gold. Create strong contrasts between light and shadow (chiaroscuro), cinematic lighting, dynamic compositions, and a sense of grandeur and spectacle. Every element should feel handcrafted, luxurious, highly detailed, expressive, and majestic while maintaining visual harmony. Ultra-realistic, museum-quality craftsmanship, cinematic atmosphere, intricate detailing, premium luxury aesthetics, 8K, professional design.

prompts.title: Aurora style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in an Aurora style.

Inspired by the mesmerizing beauty of the northern lights, create a dreamy, futuristic design featuring flowing iridescent gradients, luminous color transitions, and fluid organic forms. Emphasize soft glowing light, atmospheric blur effects, translucent layers, ethereal wave patterns, floating shapes, and subtle glass-like surfaces where appropriate. Use a vibrant yet harmonious color palette of emerald green, cyan, turquoise, sapphire blue, violet, magenta, lavender, soft pink, and hints of white light. The composition should feel weightless, immersive, and continuously flowing, with smooth gradients and ambient lighting creating a magical sense of depth. Incorporate gentle bloom, diffused reflections, volumetric light, and delicate transparency while maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic. Every element should evoke wonder, serenity, innovation, and cosmic elegance. Ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, premium digital art, futuristic luxury, highly refined, 8K, professional quality.

prompts.title: Ethereal style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in an Ethereal style.

Inspired by the delicate beauty of mist, light, and dreamlike atmospheres, create a weightless and otherworldly design that feels serene, elegant, and transcendent. Emphasize openness, soft flowing compositions, airy negative space, and subtle visual harmony. Incorporate light pastel color palettes, translucent layers, gauzy overlays, feathered shadows, soft gradients, diffused lighting, delicate textures, gentle haze, floating elements, and organic forms where appropriate. Use premium materials such as frosted glass, sheer fabric, silk, pearlescent surfaces, soft matte finishes, and subtle crystalline reflections. Apply a soothing palette of ivory, white, blush pink, lavender, pale blue, mint green, champagne, soft peach, and warm cream. Lighting should be soft, ambient, and luminous, with gentle bloom, atmospheric fog, volumetric rays, and subtle glow effects creating a sense of depth and tranquility. Typography and decorative elements should be refined, minimal, and graceful, emphasizing elegance over complexity. Every detail should evoke calm, mystery, romance, purity, and quiet luxury while maintaining a clean, sophisticated composition. Ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, premium craftsmanship, dreamy atmosphere, highly refined aesthetics, professional quality, 8K.

prompts.title: Filigree style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Filigree style.

Inspired by the timeless elegance of ornamental metalwork, create a luxurious design featuring intricate filigree patterns, delicate linework, and masterfully crafted decorative details. Emphasize graceful curves, symmetrical flourishes, ornate borders, lace-like motifs, floral arabesques, scrollwork, monograms, and refined geometric embellishments where appropriate. Incorporate metallic finishes such as polished gold, antique gold, silver, platinum, brass, and bronze, combined with rich premium materials including velvet, leather, marble, and textured paper. Use a sophisticated color palette of black, ivory, deep navy, emerald green, burgundy, charcoal, cream, antique gold, and silver. The composition should be perfectly balanced, elegant, and highly decorative without feeling cluttered. Highlight fine craftsmanship with crisp line art, embossed details, engraved textures, metallic foils, subtle shadows, and luxurious finishes. Typography should be refined and classic, complementing the ornamental aesthetic with elegant serif or monogram-inspired lettering where appropriate. Every detail should evoke heritage, prestige, refinement, and old-world luxury while maintaining exceptional clarity and visual harmony. Ultra-detailed, premium craftsmanship, luxury editorial aesthetic, museum-quality design, intricate precision, professional quality, 8K.

prompts.title: Acanthus style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in an Acanthus style.

Inspired by the timeless elegance of classical Greco-Roman architecture and the graceful foliage of the acanthus plant, create a refined design featuring flowing botanical ornamentation, symmetrical compositions, and regal decorative flourishes. Incorporate intricately carved acanthus leaves, scrolling vines, floral arabesques, Corinthian-inspired capitals, ornamental borders, engraved reliefs, classical frames, and elegant botanical motifs where appropriate. Use luxurious materials such as carved marble, limestone, polished wood, bronze, brass, aged gold, and natural stone with finely crafted textures. Apply a sophisticated color palette of ivory, cream, sage green, olive, forest green, warm beige, sandstone, charcoal, antique bronze, and muted gold. Lighting should be soft and natural, emphasizing sculptural depth, carved details, and premium craftsmanship. The composition should balance organic beauty with architectural precision, creating a harmonious blend of nature and classical elegance. Every detail should evoke heritage, refinement, endurance, and timeless luxury while maintaining exceptional visual balance and sophistication. Ultra-detailed, museum-quality craftsmanship, premium luxury aesthetics, elegant composition, cinematic lighting, professional quality, 8K.

prompts.title: Anthropomorphic style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in an Anthropomorphic style.

Transform non-human objects, animals, plants, or abstract elements into expressive characters with human-like personality, emotions, and body language. Give the subject animated facial expressions, expressive eyes, eyebrows, smiles, hands, arms, legs, gestures, and dynamic poses where appropriate, while preserving its original identity and recognizable form. Emphasize charm, relatability, storytelling, and playful interaction through exaggerated expressions, rounded silhouettes, and appealing proportions. Incorporate soft organic shapes, clean curves, character-driven details, subtle accessories, and personality-enhancing features that reinforce the subject's role. Use a vibrant, harmonious color palette with bold yet friendly colors, soft gradients, and polished textures. Lighting should be warm, bright, and inviting, highlighting expressive faces and lively movement. The composition should feel energetic, approachable, and emotionally engaging, with every detail contributing to a memorable character that appears alive and full of personality. Ultra-detailed, polished illustration, premium character design, Pixar-quality appeal, cinematic lighting, highly expressive, professional quality, 8K.

prompts.title: Pixel Art style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Pixel Art style.

Inspired by the golden age of 8-bit and 16-bit video games, create a nostalgic retro design built entirely from visible pixels and a structured grid-based aesthetic. Emphasize crisp pixel placement, simplified geometric forms, limited color palettes, and carefully crafted sprite-like details. Use authentic retro techniques such as pixel shading, dithering, anti-aliasing where appropriate, tile-based patterns, and iconic low-resolution graphics while maintaining exceptional readability. Incorporate classic game-inspired elements such as pixel environments, retro UI panels, bitmap typography, collectible items, decorative borders, and arcade-inspired visual motifs where appropriate. Apply a vibrant yet limited color palette with strong contrast, using colors reminiscent of classic consoles while preserving a cohesive visual identity. Lighting should be simulated through pixel shading rather than modern effects, creating depth with carefully placed highlights and shadows. The composition should evoke nostalgia, creativity, and playful charm while remaining polished and professionally designed. Every detail should celebrate retro gaming culture with authentic pixel craftsmanship. High-quality pixel art, authentic 8-bit/16-bit aesthetic, ultra-clean sprite work, handcrafted pixels, professional game asset quality, retro masterpiece.

prompts.title: Conceptual Sketch style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [wrench ad] in a Conceptual Sketch style. 

Inspired by the creative process of designers, architects, and illustrators, create a hand-drawn conceptual sketch that emphasizes imagination, exploration, and raw creativity over polished perfection. Use expressive pencil or ink linework, loose construction lines, confident strokes, crosshatching, scribbles, annotations, arrows, measurement marks, perspective guides, and rough shading where appropriate. Allow visible imperfections, overlapping lines, unfinished details, and spontaneous marks that communicate the evolution of an idea. Incorporate sketchbook or textured paper surfaces, subtle graphite smudges, ink washes, and lightly erased construction marks to enhance authenticity. Use a restrained color palette dominated by graphite gray, black ink, off-white paper, sepia, muted beige, and occasional accent colors for highlights or notes. The composition should feel dynamic, experimental, and thoughtfully unfinished, as though captured directly from a professional designer's notebook. Every detail should communicate innovation, ideation, craftsmanship, and artistic thinking while maintaining excellent readability and visual balance. Ultra-detailed, authentic sketchbook quality, professional concept art, handcrafted illustration, premium design process aesthetic, high resolution, 8K.
